sections.title: Donor / Acceptor
sections.description: The dye pair, from the MMFDB probes that carry the spectrum each role needs.

sections.label: Donor emission
sections.description: Donor dye: the MMFDB probes with an emission spectrum. Type to narrow the list. Its stored quantum yield fills Donor QY.

sections.label: Acceptor absorption
sections.description: Acceptor dye: the MMFDB probes with an absorption spectrum. Type to narrow the list. Its stored extinction coefficient fills Acceptor ε_max.
The spectra the overlap integral uses: kind, number of points and wavelength range.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.description: Inputs of the Foerster radius calculation.

sections.label: Donor QY
sections.description: Donor fluorescence quantum yield. Filled from the donor's MMFDB entry when it has one; otherwise it keeps its value.

sections.label: Acceptor ε_max
sections.description: Acceptor molar extinction coefficient at peak absorption; the absorption spectrum is scaled to it. Filled from the acceptor's MMFDB entry when it has one.

sections.label: Refractive index n
sections.description: Refractive index of the medium: 1.33 for water, about 1.4 inside a protein.

sections.title: Result
sections.description: R0 of the pair for κ² = 2/3; orientation is set in the model's κ² controls.

sections.label: R₀
sections.description: Förster radius for κ² = 2/3, in Å: tabulated in MMFDB for the pair if it is (marked cached), else computed from the spectra.
The overlap integral J, or that R₀ is MMFDB's tabulated value, or why there is no result.

buttons.label: Apply R₀ to model
buttons.description: Write R₀ into the model's Förster radius and close the calculator.
